managed_reference_rule: A caller-selected managed KMS reference requires either an active profile for the same tenant, service, requested purpose and algorithm, or a live tenant-namespaced managed inventory alias with a matching registered purpose, purpose-category prefix and per-key algorithm. A registry purpose binding alone cannot authorize a managed reference.
managed_binding_update_rule: Public configuration updates, including legacy-shaped bodies without a services array, preserve existing managed KMS purpose bindings and cannot create or change them; managed key creation and issuer profile binding own those records.
reviewed_security_tightening: A caller-selected key_reference must be the registered default, a registered service alias, a registry purpose binding, or a reference on an active issuer profile for the same tenant and service; an unknown KMS name is rejected before signing. Internal signing compatibility is unchanged.
